channel.title: Korea Plainly: places to visit
channel.description: Places worth visiting across Korea, for first-time visitors.

item.title: Hyangilam Hermitage: A Sea-Cliff Temple in Yeosu
item.description: Hyangilam is a Buddhist hermitage perched above the sea, worth visiting for its rocky approach and sweeping coastal views.

item.title: Yeonggeumjeong Sunrise Pavilion: Sea Views in Sokcho
item.description: Yeonggeumjeong is a seaside pavilion on a rocky outcrop, reached by a bridge and prized for its open views of the East Sea.

item.title: Sokcho Tourist & Fishery Market: A Taste of the Coast
item.description: Sokcho Tourist & Fishery Market is a lively traditional market where you can browse local goods and sample the city’s coastal food culture.

item.title: Naksansa Temple: A Seaside Sanctuary Above the East Sea
item.description: Naksansa is a historic Buddhist temple overlooking the East Sea, worth visiting for its coastal views, quiet courtyards and cliffside shrines.

item.title: Biseondae Peak: Seoraksan’s Scenic Rock Terrace
item.description: Biseondae is a striking rock terrace beside a mountain stream, reached by a rewarding walk into Seoraksan National Park.

item.title: Seoraksan National Park: Sokcho’s mountain gateway
item.description: Seoraksan National Park’s Seorak-dong district is a scenic mountain gateway, with temple grounds, hiking trails and access to dramatic peaks.

item.title: Songdo Central Park: A waterfront walk in Incheon
item.description: Songdo Central Park is a modern city park with a broad canal, open lawns and skyline views—an easy place to slow down in Incheon.

item.title: Korean Traditional Culture Center (East): Airport gifts
item.description: This Terminal 2 gift shop offers a convenient last look at Korean culture and a chance to choose a meaningful souvenir before you fly.

item.title: Incheon Grand Park: A Green Escape in the City
item.description: Incheon Grand Park is a spacious city park with a zoo, botanical garden and room to unwind among green landscapes.

item.title: Incheon Chinatown: A Food-and-History Guide to Korea’s Open-Port District

item.description: Hyeopjae Beach is a west-coast stop known for pale sand, clear-looking blue-green water and views toward Biyangdo Island. It suits a relaxed beach walk, a…

item.title: Jeju Traditional Five-Day Market: A taste of local life
item.description: This lively traditional market brings Jeju produce, food and everyday shopping together on a five-day schedule.

item.title: Jeju Leports Land: Outdoor Kart Racing in Jeju
item.description: Jeju Leports Land is an outdoor go-kart venue where you can race a long track and add active attractions to a Jeju day.
